name: 37334 · Fayetteville, TN
findings: ZIP 37334 (Fayetteville) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37334 (Fayetteville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37334 (Fayetteville) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).
